note: THE CONTROL for `^'. Both sides answer (0 0 0 0): at the start of the pattern, after `\\|', after `\\(' and after `\\(?:'. Note what this case deliberately does NOT ask: whether `^' matches after a NEWLINE in the subject. It does in Emacs and does not in kg, that is a separate recorded divergence (`phase26-anchor-caret-is-not-backtick', line anchor versus subject anchor), and this item must not be read as closing it.
